messages:
anya: Quick Q — Chris is being promoted from IC -> Eng Manager with an effective date of 2026-06-01. Can we confirm payroll cutoff, backpay timing, bonus proration for Q2, and how to get an RSU grant aligned to the promotion date?
chris: Prefer single lump-sum backpay. Also want to avoid off-cycle fees if possible.
mina: Payroll cutoff for the June mid-month run is 2026-06-03 COB. To hit that run, HR change and comp packet should be submitted by 2026-06-02 COB. If missed, we can request an off-cycle (takes ~3 business days). Promotions typically waive the off-cycle fee.
anya: What exact docs do we need to submit?
mina: Required: signed "Comp Change Request" PDF, manager approval email, employee ID, new salary & bonus target, desired effective date, and GL code (format: HR-OP-XXX). Send to payroll@redwood.com.
chris: How is backpay calculated for a 6/1 effective?
mina: Backpay = (new annual salary / pay periods) * number of pay periods already paid at old rate or prorated by days for mid-periods. We put it as one line item "Promotion Backpay - <name>".
anya: Bonus proration details? Chris earned some commission in May under the old target.
mina: Already-earned commissions/bonuses follow plan rules and won't be clawed back. New target proration = (days under manager target in quarter / total days in quarter) * target.
comp-committee: FYI: Manager RSU grants require comp committee approval. To request a grant with a 6/1 grant date, submit the comp packet (current comp, proposed comp, business rationale, org snapshot) by 2026-06-02 so committee can review on 2026-06-03. If committee approves after that date, grant issuance date will reflect approval date and may not be retroactively set to 6/1.
chris: If committee approval comes later, can paperwork ask for retroactive grant date?
comp-committee: Retroactive grant dates are very limited and must be escalated; standard practice is grant date = approval date.
anya: Any benefits/401k impacts?
mina: Benefits eligibility changes are governed by the HR effective date but payroll deductions follow the payroll run when change is processed. Manager-specific programs (e.g., manager training stipend) activate after payroll processes the job change. 401k deferrals follow the next payroll deduction cycle.
payroll-bot: Reminder: include GL code HR-OP- followed by 3 digits on the comp form. Attach signed comp change PDF + manager approval when emailing payroll@redwood.com.
anya: Action items: 1) Anya to collect signed form + manager approval and send to payroll@redwood.com by 2026-06-02 COB; 2) Mina to confirm GL code and backpay calc once packet received; 3) If equity desired, Anya to submit comp packet to comp committee by 2026-06-02. Thanks all :thumbsup:
